resources.string: Props read via getprop · No root / ADB required
(Result may be inaccurate — please verify by inserting a foreign SIM card)

SSU (Service Software Unlock) is Samsung's regional SIM lock temporary unlock mechanism, granted by Samsung to allow a locked device to use SIM cards from a supported region.

⚠️ SSU is NOT permanent. Your device can be re-locked at any time — after an OTA update, factory reset, or remote revocation by Samsung.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📊 Status Meanings

✅ Global Unlocked — No SIM lock. Device can use any compatible SIM.

✅ Global Unlocked (Official Permanent Unlock) — ssu.status=perm_unlock. Samsung has permanently unlocked this device.

😓 Official Temporary (Travel) Unlock — ssu.status=temp_unlock. Samsung has granted a temporary unlock for travel. Device may re-lock after the period ends.

🔒 SSU Locked — ssu.status=default. Device is locked via SSU mechanism.

🔒 Locked (Carrier/Region Lock, not SSU) — ssu.status=lock. Device is carrier or region locked through a non-SSU method.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📱 ATT Devices — S25 and Earlier

For AT&T devices (S931, S936, S937, S938, F766, F966 series) before S26, SSU does not apply. Check unlock status through AT&T or Samsung directly.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔬 Chip Accuracy

✅ Accurate: SM8650 (Snapdragon 8 Gen 4) and newer.

⚠️ May be inaccurate: SM8350, SM8450, SM8550 and non-Qualcomm (Exynos, MediaTek) — result shown with 🤔 warning. Please verify by inserting a foreign SIM card.
